svg.aria-label: Architecture of the highly available website on Amazon EC2
svg.title: Architecture of the highly available website on Amazon EC2

g.text: 1 Visitor sends an HTTP request to the Internet Gateway. 2 It reaches the Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.
3 The load balancer forwards to the web servers in the private subnets. 4 Servers reach the internet only outbound, through the NAT Gateway.
5 The page's JavaScript runs in the browser and calls the Lambda Function URLs. EventBridge runs the RSS function daily.
